name: Washerwoman
description: Each night, choose a player: learn their role and alignment

name: Librarian
description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): learn one of their roles

name: Investigator
description: Each night, choose two players: learn if one of them is the Demon

name: Cook
description: Each night, learn if the two closest alive players are on the same team

name: Pacifist
description: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe

name: Blue Executioner
description: Each night, choose a player: if they die, you become an Outsider

name: Red Widow
description: If you are alive, the Demon's attacks may affect other players

name: Poisoner
description: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned until next night

name: Spy
description: Each night, view the Grimoire. You might register as a Townsfolk or Minion

name: Baron
description: You start knowing how many Outsiders are in play

name: Widow
description: Once per game, during the day, choose a player: they are executed

name: Imp
description: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you die, the game continues

name: Vigormortis
description: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The first time you die, you live

name: Leviathan
description: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you are alive, no execution

name: Queen
description: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they become the King

name: Jester
description: If you are executed, you win. All players know you are dead
